title: Intelligent UI test
summary: Test button interaction and saved state.
html:
0

Count range: 0–99. Increase it, scroll away and back, then reload or reopen Deck. The same count should return.
js: const out=document.getElementById('count');const status=document.getElementById('status');const minus=document.getElementById('minus');const plus=document.getElementById('plus');const bridge=window.generatedUI;const saved=bridge?.widgetState;let count=Number.isInteger(saved?.count)&&saved.count>=0&&saved.count<=99?saved.count:0;function render(){out.textContent=String(count);minus.disabled=count===0;plus.disabled=count===99;}function save(){render();try{if(typeof bridge?.setWidgetState!=='function')throw new Error('Unavailable');bridge.setWidgetState({count});status.textContent='Save requested. Scroll away or reload to check restoration.';}catch{status.textContent='Saving is unavailable or failed. The buttons still work for this session.';}}minus.onclick=()=>{count=Math.max(0,count-1);save();};plus.onclick=()=>{count=Math.min(99,count+1);save();};document.getElementById('reset').onclick=()=>{count=0;save();};render();status.textContent=saved&&Number.isInteger(saved.count)&&saved.count>=0&&saved.count<=99?'Restored saved count: '+count+'.':'Ready. Change the count to test saving.';
